caption:
🚆 One day of trains in Great Britain — Thursday 15 October 2026.

22,122 trains, every operator from LNER and Avanti to Northern, ScotRail and Southern. London's commuter web dominates: 1,690 trains on the move at 07:50, 1,675 at 17:52.

📊 Data: National Rail timetable, GTFS by travelwhiz (CC BY 4.0). Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
